claims.claim: Belurat's interior is not a single direct line from its entry grace to the Divine Beast. The left branch reaches Small Private Altar, then the rooftop/spiral-stair route reaches Stagefront beside the theatre doors, and only then does the player approach the Divine Beast Dancing Lion.

Rauh Base is the lower valley beneath the Ancient Ruins. Ancient Ruins Base connects southwest to Temple Town Ruins; from Temple Town the river runs north to Ravine North, where the route climbs the eastern slope. These are separate lower-layer graces rather than aliases of the upper Ancient Ruins graces.

Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway is an upper Rauh grace reached from Rauh Ancient Ruins, West through the southwest temple, lattice/platform route and elevator. It is not reachable by simply treating Temple Town Ruins as the same elevation or by collapsing all Rauh graces into a single surface point.
